description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GeneralServiceException' used for handling service-related errors within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class extends a base exception and provides methods for managing error messages, including constructing error maps and adding error messages.

classes.name: GeneralServiceException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for representing errors during service execution within the OFBiz framework. It encapsulates error messages, error maps, nested service results, and provides methods for error handling and reporting.
